mapper.update: UPDATE sheet_conversions SET status='FAILED',stage=NULL,failure_code='SERVER_ERROR',failure_cause='DELETED',finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT recording_url FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND recording_url IS NOT NULL
SELECT id FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE nr FROM note_results nr JOIN evaluations e ON e.id = nr.evaluation_id JOIN practice_sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = NULL, password_hash = NULL, nickname = NULL, status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = #{now}, withdrawal_requested_at = NULL, purge_scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'WITHDRAWAL_PENDING'
